You will ensure all surface preparation and protective coating work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project specifications, Australian Standards, and client requirements.

•	Mix paints and coatings in accordance with manufacturer specifications and project requirements.
•	Inspect prepared surfaces and completed coatings to ensure compliance with quality standards and required film thickness.
•	Perform touch-up work, maintenance painting, and coating repairs on mining and industrial equipment.
•	Safely operate blasting equipment, spray-painting equipment, compressors, and other associated tools.
•	Conduct routine maintenance and cleaning of painting and blasting equipment.

•	Work collaboratively with supervisors, engineers, and other trades to meet project deadlines.
•	Assist with shutdown, maintenance, fabrication, and construction projects as required.
•	Follow all workplace health and safety policies, procedures, and environmental requirements.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1–2 years of full-time experience as a Painter Blaster or in a similar industrial coatings role.
•	Experience in abrasive blasting, surface preparation, and industrial protective coatings.
•	Knowledge of industrial paint systems, coating application techniques, and quality inspection procedures.
•	Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and coating specifications.
•	Experience working in mining, oil and gas, construction, or heavy industrial environments is highly regarded.
•	Strong commitment to workplace safety, quality workmanship, and environmental compliance.
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
•	Excellent communication and organisational skills.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.

•	Ongoing training and career development.

On behalf of our client Gulf Hydraulic, we are seeking a qualified Fitter General, fitter and turners /Machinists for a full-time position in Malaga. Gulf Hydraulics Australia is a leader in the Hydraulics Industry for the service and repair of Hydraulic Pumps, Motors and Cylinders and has been recognised as service provider for the offshore, industrial and mining sectors.

Primary responsibilities Fitters and Turners
 
- Assembled and fitted precision hydraulic cylinder components, including barrels, rods, pistons, glands, and specialized seal kits, to full operational compliance.
- Operated workshop machinery and heavy press equipment to accurately install interference-fit bushes and components.
- Conducted diagnostic pressure testing, including bypass and static pressure leak testing, to verify fluid power integrity and safety standards.
- Utilized precision hand tools and torque equipment to tighten fasteners and sub-assemblies to exact OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) specifications.
- Maintained quality control records, documented test data, and assigned unique job identifiers/ID tracking to completed units prior to final surface finishing (coating/spraying).
- Setting up and operating conventional lathes and milling machines to turn, face, thread, or bore metal stock.
- Machining new or worn parts (like reclaiming a worn cylinder rod or machining a new gland/piston from scratch) to exact tolerances.
- Using engineering drawings and precision measuring tools (micrometers, vernier calipers) to machine components down to the millimeter.

Primary responsibilities Machinist
•     Operate machine tools such as lathes, milling machines,
•     Manufacture rods, glands, pistons, barrels, bases, fittings, bushes
•     Review specifications for a job.
•     Calculate where to cut or bore.
•     Shape steel, aluminum, other materials.
•     Determine how fast or slow workpiece is fed into machine.
•     Determine how much material to remove.
•     Select tools and materials for the job.
•     Plan the sequence of cutting and finishing operations.
•     Mark the workpiece to show where cuts should be made.
•     Position workpiece on the lathe or milling machine.
•     Monitor and control feed rate and speed.
•     Ensure workpiece is properly lubricated and/or cooled.
•     Regulate temperature of workpiece.
•     Detect problems by listening for specific sounds.
•     Adjust cutting speed to compensate for harmonic vibrations.
•     Monitor the accuracy of cuts.
•     Replace dull cutting tools.
•     Check accuracy of work against specifications.
•     Ability to use precision tools (eg. Micrometers internal & external)
•     Use manual machinery.

Qualifications/Knowledge/Skills/Experience
 
•     Adequate work experience or Certificate Ill in Engineering - Mechanical Trade (Fitter & Machinist)
•     Good mechanical aptitude.
•     Excellent reading comprehension
•     Physical Stamina


The salary range is from $79,500 to $85,000 per year plus super.

result.description:
Job Details
-  Occupation: Project Administrator
-  Base Pay: $80,000 - $90,000 + Super
-  Contract Type: Permanent
-  Work Type: Full Time
-  Industry: Height Safety Services
-  Sector: Privately Held Company

About the Role
Safe Height Pty Ltd trading as SAFE MOUNT are a specialist provider of Height Safety Compliance  Solutions across SEQ. Our services include System Design, Installation of Height Safety Systems, Certification and Audit, as well as Harness & PPE Inspection services. Due to continued growth, we are seeking an experienced Project Administrator to support the planning, coordination and administration of multiple concurrent projects and service programs for the existing and new clients. The role requires regular travel along southeast Queensland between various projects with possible interstate trips. This role suits a highly capable, analytically-minded professional — potentially with an engineering, scientific, mining or other complex industrial background — who can quickly learn technical and regulatory frameworks, interpret data and adapt across multiple concurrent, complex projects as per various customers’ requirements. 

Skills
-  Project Coordination
-  Contract Administration
-  Contract Management
-  Project Scheduling
-  Microsoft Excel
-  Project Reporting
-  Contractor Management
-  Stakeholder Management
-  Compliance Management
-  Document Control
-  Change Management
-  Data Analysis
-  Bluebeam Revu 

Skills & Experience
-  Tertiary qualification in a technical, engineering, scientific, project management, business or related discipline.
-  Background in engineering, construction, mining, resources, manufacturing or other complex industrial/technical sectors will be highly regarded.
-  Minimum 3 years’ experience in project coordination, project administration, project controls or similar project support roles.
-  Demonstrated experience managing interfaces between clients, contractors, suppliers and technical professionals.
-  Experience coordinating projects involving technical design, site installation works, contractor management and regulatory compliance requirements.
-  Experience in schedule monitoring, progress tracking and project performance reporting.
-  Experience in communication with different levels of stakeholders from site labour to decision makers in the client's procurement team
-  Experience supporting project change management and contract variation processes.
-  Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including reporting, forecasting, data analysis and performance tracking.
-  Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
-  Strong analytical and organisational abilities.
-  Demonstrated ability to rapidly learn, analyse and apply new technical, regulatory and operational information across complex, fast-moving project environments.
-  Reading CAD drawings and liaising with Design Project managers and Development Managers

Main Duties / Responsibilities
-  Coordinate and administer height safety compliance inspection programs, system installation projects, and design services.
-  Develop, maintain and review project schedules, work programs, resource plans and project documentation.
-  Prepare and coordinate tender documentation, service agreements, work orders and contract documentation, ensuring project requirements, pricing, scope changes and approvals are accurately recorded throughout the project lifecycle.
-  Coordinate day-to-day communication and workflow between clients, engineers, contractors, installers, inspectors and suppliers to ensure activities are delivered safely, efficiently and in accordance with project schedules.
-  Monitor project and service delivery performance against contractual requirements, compliance obligations and client expectations.
-  Act as a key point of contact for clients, contractors and suppliers by coordinating responses to project enquiries, facilitating communication between stakeholders and assisting with the timely resolution of operational issues.
-  Maintain accurate electronic project records, inspection reports, certification documentation, drawings, registers and compliance documentation to support project delivery and audit requirements.
-  Compile project performance information from multiple operational sources, analyse trends and prepare management reports covering project progress, productivity, compliance performance and service delivery outcomes.
-  Support project change management processes, including assessment, documentation and tracking of project variations.
-  Monitor contractor activities against agreed schedules, scopes of work and project milestones, identifying delays, quality concerns or scope changes requiring management review.
-  Support procurement and subcontractor coordination activities.
-  Prepare project documentation including client reports, operational summaries, project status updates, meeting papers and internal business documentation to support decision-making.
-  Provide project support to senior management by monitoring project risks, escalating critical issues, coordinating follow-up actions and assisting with implementation of operational decisions.
-  Identify delivery risks, compliance issues and operational constraints that may affect project schedules or client commitments.
-  Coordinate height safety inspection, installation and certification activities to ensure compliance with regulatory and client requirements.
-  Monitor contractor performance and support continuous improvement initiatives across projects and service programs.
Experience
-  To be considered for this role, applicants must demonstrate a minimum of 3 years’ experience in project coordination, project administration, project controls or similar project support roles within engineering, construction, industrial services, infrastructure, compliance or other relevant technical service environments. 

Performance Goals
-  Timely delivery of height safety projects and annual compliance service programs.
-  Effective planning, scheduling and delivery of projects from tender stage to practical completion and handover
-  Accurate and effective project reporting.
-  Efficient coordination of contractors, suppliers and stakeholders.
-  Compliance with contractual, regulatory and client requirements.
-  Continuous improvement of project administration, reporting and coordination processes.

Other Requirements
-  Current, open driver’s licence, with willingness to travel regularly across South East Queensland and occasionally interstate.

How to Apply
Submit a resume and cover letter to info@safemount.com.au or via the application link.
We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, cultural background, disability or other protected attributes.
